==Overview==
This category contains two broad classes of page:
* Essays and [[historical research]] documents detailing with past events. A list of historical research projects commissioned since the start of the campaign can be found in  the [[Historical_research#Recent_Historical_Research|recent historical research]] list. 
* Pages concerned with historical figures such as previous Thrones, or Alderei the Fair. Right now this explicitly does ''not'' include primarily religious figures who are known mainly as [[paragons and exemplars]], except where there has been significant historical research in play.
